calibration_sources: KTransformers (Tsinghua MADSys) & Fiddler GPU-CPU Heterogeneous MoE Execution Model
FlexGen (ICML) Zig-Zag Block Schedule & DeepSpeed ZeRO-Infinity Offload Bandwidth Amortization
PCIe Gen5 x16 (52 GB/s) Weight Transfer vs Dual-Socket 24-Channel DDR5 (760 GB/s) + Intel AMX In-Place Compute

workload_baseline.model: DeepSeek-R1 671B MoE (380 GB Q4_K_M, 37B Active per Token)
workload_baseline.server_spec: 1x 48GB GPU + Dual-Socket Xeon/EPYC (512 GB DDR5 @ 760 GB/s) — $18,500 Total CapEx

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive OS Swap / CUDA Unified Memory (cudaMallocManaged On-Demand Page Faults)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 原生 OS Swap / CUDA Unified Memory 缺页中断 (按需 4KB/64KB 缺页拉取)
tiers.execution_paradigm: GPU faults on missing expert pages -> PCIe 64KB thrashing -> GPU computes

tiers.name: Tier 2: Layer-Wise Weight DMA Offloading (HuggingFace accelerate device_map / Pinned H2D Copy)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 按层权重 DMA 搬运卸载 (把 17GB 激活专家权重每 Token 从内存拷进 GPU 计算)
tiers.execution_paradigm: Pinned RAM -> Async cudaMemcpyAsync of 17 GB active weights over PCIe (52 GB/s) -> GPU GEMM

tiers.name: Tier 3: Throughput-Oriented Zig-Zag Block Offload (FlexGen / ZeRO-Infinity Column-Major Sweep)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 吞吐导向 Zig-Zag 列优先批量卸载 (FlexGen / ZeRO-Infinity 离线大批次平摊权重搬运)
tiers.execution_paradigm: Loads 1 layer weight once and sweeps across N=128 large batches before advancing to next layer

tiers.name: Tier 4: Heterogeneous Compute-In-Place (KTransformers / Fiddler: GPU MLA+Hot Experts + CPU AMX/DDR5 Cold Experts)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 异构算子原位协同 (KTransformers / Fiddler: GPU 跑 MLA 与热专家 + 双路 CPU AMX 在 DDR5 原位算冷专家)
tiers.execution_paradigm: Weights NEVER cross PCIe! GPU sends 32 KB activation vector -> Dual-Socket CPU AMX computes experts at 760 GB/s DDR5
